item.title: SHAFT 0.85.0
item.description:
Meetings transcribe more faithfully, record from Siri and the Lock Screen, and notifications can be allowed from

Settings (#74).

  • Per-meeting Words and People (vocabulary and speaker count, then reprocess); the meeting's own words survive Whisper's prompt cut; unsure chunks re-read in the other language; invitees suggested as names.
  • Siri, Shortcuts and Control Center start and stop a recording; iPhone Live Activity with elapsed time and Stop.
  • Microphone meters; recording time in the Mac menu bar; voice mode and meetings never together on the Mac; damaged iPhone recordings shareable or deletable; failed meetings say why.
  • Settings -> Notifications: Allow Notifications, Open Notification Settings, or Register Again.
